tei:div.tei:p: 91)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'og min mkha' spyod zhing du skye ba'i smon lam dri med nor bu bzhugs so: na mo badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye: rang snang lhun grub 'og min dag pa'i gnas: mkha' spyod sgyu 'phrul ye shes las grub pa'i: zhing dang gzhal yas bkod pa rab rdzogs dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'bar ba'i steng: 'jigs byed dus mtshan pho mo'i ro gdan la: rnam kun mchog ldan don gyis rnal 'byor ma: mkha' spyod dbang mo zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe ldan: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug mthur du 'phyar: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang phrag g.yon steng: rdubs tshul mdzad cing zhabs gnyis mnyam stabs bzhengs: spyan gsum mkhar gzigs dbu skra zar bu grol: thod skam rtse bran rin chen dar dpyangs 'phyang: phyag rgya lnga dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: thod rlon do shal mchan g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ brten: ye shes 'ja' 'od me ri 'khyil ba'i klong: snang stong ye shes sgyu 92) ma'i sku ru bzhugs: 'khor du ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro dang: phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma: grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs: tshe 'di 'phos tshe lha tshogs mjal bar shog: mdor na 'og min mkha' spyod zhing khams kyi: rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad dang: rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus 'khor bcas la: phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi snying nas gsol ba 'debs: thugs rjes dgongs la smon lam 'grub par mdzod: bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du: mkha' spyod dbang mo'i myur lam la brten nas: rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la 'jug pa'i mthus: dpal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i lus thob ste: mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing: bslab pa gsum gyi gnad la rab brtson nas: sdom gsum dri mas ma gos bsrung nus shog:

yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur bla ma la: mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog phul phyin nas: thugs rgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs:smin grol gnyis kyi snod du rung bar shog: theg pa kun gyi mchog gyur gsang ba 93)sngags: yo ga gsum gyi dgongs pa'i gnad kyi mchog: ma hā yo ga nyams su blang tsam gyis: snod bcud rnam dag gzugs snang lha skur smin: sgra grags sngags dang dran rtog chos nyid ngang: dag rdzogs smin gsum 'bras bu mthar phyin shog: a nu yo ga nyams su blang tsam gyis: rlung bcu las rung bogs 'byin brtan thob cing: 'khor lo lnga po'i mdud pa rab grol nas: kha sbyor bdun ldan rig sku mngon gyur shog: a ti yo ga nyams su blang tsam gyis: sku gsum ye shes chen po mngon gyur cing: rang rig 'gyur ba med pa'i gding thob nas: gzhon nu bum skur yang dag sangs rgyas shog: thod rgal gsang lam nyams su blang tsam gyis: snang ba bzhi yi nyams rtsal rab rdzogs nas: ma dag snang ba dag dbyings dwangs ma ru: go 'phos 'ja' lus 'pho chen 'grub par shog: nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed dbyings nub tshe: 'chi ba dang por ka dag rang dbang thob: gnyis pas rang gdangs ye shes mngon du gyur: gsum pas ngang gnas gtan srid zin par shog: gal te bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: mkha' spyod dbang mo'i thugs 94)rje'i 'od zer gyis: rjes dran drug la brtan pa rab thob nas: bzang ngan 'brel bcas 'gro ba ma lus pa: 'og min mkha' spyod zhing du 'dren nus pa'i: ded dpon mchog tu bdag nyid 'gyur bar shog: dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang: chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang: mkha' spyod gsang ba ye shes thugs rje'i mthus: smon bzhin gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par shog:

de ltar mos gus drag po yis: smon lam 'di la brtson gyur na: nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus babs tshe: mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mas: lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste: dag pa'i zhing du 'dren par nges: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: the tshom can la skal ba chad: las skal ldan dang 'di 'phrad shog: skal med rnams la gu h+ya rgya: bka' srung tshe ring mched lngas srungs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: rbas rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang shākya'i dge btsun dam pa bde 'byung gis dus ring mo nas nan cher yang yang bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du ser dgon dben gnas mtshams khrod 'od gsal ljongs kyi nye 'dabs nas sprang 'khyams kun bzang chos nyid bde skyong dbang mos 'khrul snang yig 95) ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// ༈ 'phrul yig las g.yu lo bkod du skye ba'i smon lam phan bde'i myu gu bzhugs: na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra ye: rang snang rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams mchog: rang byung lhun grub gser gyi sa gzhi brdal: yan lag brgyad ldan khrus dang rdzing bu 'khyil: shing dang me tog 'bras bu sna tshogs smin: bya dang ri dwags mang pos chos sgra sgrog: phyogs rnams thams cad dri bsung spos ngad ldang: lha yi bu dang bu mo'i tshogs rnams kyis: mchod pa du mas rtag tu mchod cing bstod: de dbus rin chen sna tshogs gcal bkram dbus: baiḍūr+ya las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang: rang byung pho brang nyams dga' lta na sdug: phyi gsal nang gsal gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa: rta babs chos 'khor rgyal mtshan gdugs dang ni: rgyan dang khor yug mtshan nyid rab rdzogs dbus: ma chags skyon bral pad zla rgyas pa'i steng: rgyal ba'i thugs rje las 'khrungs 'phags ma sgrol: sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhi dpal: lhang nge lhan ne lham mer bzhugs pa la: 'khor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang: sgrol ma nyer 96)gcig 'bum phrag mkha' 'gros bskor:

gsang sngags chos sgra rgyun chad med par sgrog: thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs te rol: bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du: rje btsun ma khyod lhag pa'i lhar bzung nas: sgo gsum gcig dre+il dad pas gsol ba 'debs: phyi na so byang spyod pa skyong tshul dang: nang na zab mo rdo rje theg pa yi: ma nor rim gnyis lam mchog mngon gyur nas: myur du bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod: skyid dam sdug gam legs nyes ci byung yang: rje btsun sgrol ma khyed rang mkhyen lags pas: bdag rgyud smin cing grol ba'i mthu nus stsol: bla med theg pa'i lam mchog la zhugs tsheḥ nyams rtogs yon tan gong du 'phel ba dang: gol 'chug med pa'i sa lam mngon gyur nas: rang rig 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo bar: ka dag kun tu bzang por sangs rgyas shog: mdor na bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: rje btsun ma khyod yid la bsam pa yis: skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru: zhing mchog g.yu lo bkod du skye bar shog: zhing der skyes nas lung bstan rab thob 97)ste: gdul dka' 'dul phyir phrin las rgya mtsho yis: gang la gang 'dul de la der mthun gyis: khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs nus shog: chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang: chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med bden pa yis: smon pa'i don la bar chad mi 'byung zhing: myur du re 'bras yongs su 'grub gyur cig: 'di la rgyun du brtson gyur na: lha mo mchog gis rjes bzung nas: 'chi ba'i lam ma mi ltos par: 'od gsal dgongs pa mngon gyur nas: chos sku'i gtan srid zin 'gyur ro: bka' srung re ma ti ye+is srungs: las skal ldan pa'i dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang rdo rje 'dzin pa mtshams pa lhun grub rig 'dzin dang*/ rigs ldan ma dbang mo/ dad ldan slob bu chos dbyings rdo rje sogs kyis nam mkha'i mdangs 'dzin gyi phreng ba dang lha ri+eg bcas nan cher yang yang bskul ngor zhal ngo mi ldog tsam du snyom las pa 'chol mo kun bzang chos nyid dbang mo'am bde ba'i rdo rjes ser dgon dben phrod nas gtan la phabs pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin skyes bu tshul khrims rdo rjes bgyis pa'o//
